```yaml
name: PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Brin Security Scan
        id: brin-scan
        run: |
          # Install Brin CLI
          npm install -g @brin/security-cli
          
          # Run security scan on the PR commits
          # This will output JSON format for easier parsing
          brin scan --format json > brin-results.json || echo "No results generated"
          
          # Check if we have results
          if [ -f "brin-results.json" ]; then
            echo "BRIN_RESULTS_FILE=brin-results.json" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Parse Brin Results
        id: parse-results
        if: env.BRIN_RESULTS_FILE != ''
        run: |
          # Extract key metrics from Brin results
          BLOCKING=$(jq -r '.findings[] | select(.severity == "blocking") | .id' brin-results.json | wc -l)
          REVIEW=$(jq -r '.findings[] | select(.severity == "review") | .id' brin-results.json | wc -l)
          INCONCLUSIVE=$(jq -r '.findings[] | select(.severity == "inconclusive") | .id' brin-results.json | wc -l)
          DANGEROUS=$(jq -r '.findings[] | select(.dangerous == true) | .id' brin-results.json | wc -l)
          SCORE=$(jq -r '.score // 0' brin-results.json)
          
          echo "BLOCKING_COUNT=$BLOCKING" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "REVIEW_COUNT=$REVIEW" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "INCONCLUSIVE_COUNT=$INCONCLUSIVE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "DANGEROUS_COUNT=$DANGEROUS" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SCORE=$SCORE" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Generate Summary Comment
        id: generate-comment
        if: env.BRIN_RESULTS_FILE != ''
        run: |
          COMMENT_BODY="## 🛡️ Brin Security Scan Results\n\n"
          
          if [ "${{ env.DANGEROUS_COUNT }}" -gt 0 ] || [ "${{ env.SCORE }}" -lt 30 ]; then
            COMMENT_BODY+="⚠️ **Security Issues Found**\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="- **Dangerous Findings**: ${{ env.DANGEROUS_COUNT }}\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="- **Score**: ${{ env.SCORE }}/100\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="\nThis PR will fail the security check due to critical issues.\n"
          else
            COMMENT_BODY+="✅ **All Clear**\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="- **Blocking Issues**: ${{ env.BLOCKING_COUNT }}\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="- **Review Issues**: ${{ env.REVIEW_COUNT }}\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="- **Inconclusive Issues**: ${{ env.INCONCLUSIVE_COUNT }}\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="- **Score**: ${{ env.SCORE }}/100\n"
            COMMENT_BODY+="\nNo critical issues found. PR is safe to merge.\n"
          fi
          
          echo "COMMENT_BODY<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$COMMENT_BODY" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Update Pull Request Comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: ${{ env.COMMENT_BODY }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: "brin-security-scan"

      - name: Fail Check on Critical Issues
        if: env.DANGEROUS_COUNT > 0 || env.SCORE < 30
        run: |
          echo "Security scan failed due to dangerous findings or low score"
          exit 1
```
